## `pm:queue` → `pm:blocked` — PR #7456 already implements this ruling. ⛔ Do not dispatch it a second time.

`domain:ui` execution seat, session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`.

**Blocked-by:** #6939
**Unlock-action:** re-check PR #7456

### Why

This card is ruled (2026-09-01, batch D, verbatim 「同意」, option 2 — retire `children` from `ContextMenuSchema`). Independently, #6939's own ruling assigned its `tooltip` + `context-menu` group the same retirement, and that group was dispatched and delivered this morning as **PR #7456** (draft, awaiting the project director seat).

I verified by content on that PR's branch (`9ecd3b0af`) against `origin/main`, rather than trusting either PR body:

| ref | `children` on `ContextMenuSchema` (and `TooltipSchema`) |
|---|---|
| `origin/main` | live **required** declarations — `zod/overlay.zod.ts:190` and `overlay.ts:521` (tooltip at `:108` / `:300`) |
| PR #7456's branch | **zero live declarations** — every remaining hit is a `*` comment line |

The only surviving live `children` in those files is `MenuItemSchema`'s submenu key, a different member. Control on the same commands and refs: `ContextMenuSchema` fires 2× in `overlay.zod.ts` on **both** sides, so the zeros are absences and not a broken pathspec.

⇒ This card's ruled outcome lands with PR #7456. Dispatching it separately would have two branches retiring the same member in the same file.

### Why blocked rather than closed

The PR has not merged. Closing now would record an outcome that does not yet exist on `main`. When #7456 lands, re-run the by-content check above and close this card as completed, referencing that PR.

### ⚠️ Two honest limitations of this state

1. **The `Blocked-by:` / `Unlock-action:` lines are in this comment, not in the card body.** I did not rewrite the body: an MCP body round-trip (read → edit → write) is a known corruption path — bodies come back HTML-entity-escaped (`'` / `"`), so writing one back mangles the original text. ⚠️ That means this card is one of the population #6653 measured — a `pm:blocked` card the unlock scan's reverse index cannot see. It is tracked instead by this seat's own check-in and by #6939's group table, and a seat with REST write access should move these two lines into the body.
2. This card's ruling carries a **family note** I am not acting on: same retire-a-dialect class as #6771 (ruled batch A), with an invitation to evaluate the five family gates for a combined dispatch. That evaluation has not been done and is not blocked by anything here.

## Closed — resolved by PR #7456, verified by content on `origin/main`

`domain:ui` execution seat, session `session_01EMrWaQw3XS5DxTHxp4yRyC`. `pm:blocked` stripped; closed as completed.

This card offered three options. **#7456 took option 2 — retire it**, which this card called the enforce-or-remove answer that makes `trigger` unambiguously the one spelling.

### ⭐ The reading, and why the obvious probe would have said the opposite

Naively counting the word `children` in `packages/types/src/zod/overlay.zod.ts`:

| | occurrences of `children` |
|---|--:|
| before #7456 (`ed27d7c19`) | 3 |
| `origin/main` (`a4514e840`) | **9** |

**Three times more, on the change that removed it.** Every added occurrence is the retirement's own prose — *"This member used to REQUIRE `children`"*, *"No read site has ever consumed `children` here"*, *"`basic-tooltip` was ALREADY moved from `children` to `trigger`"*. A count-based close-condition would have concluded the key was still there and more entrenched than before.

Reading the **declaration form** instead:

| | `^\s*children:\s*z\.` | control (`trigger|content|body`) |
|---|--:|--:|
| before | **3** — incl. `:190` *Context menu children* | 14 |
| `origin/main` | **1** — only `MenuItemSchema` submenu items | 16 |

⇒ `ContextMenuSchema.children` is gone; the surviving declaration is `MenuItemSchema.children` (submenu items), a different and live key. The control fires non-zero on both sides, so the 1 is a reading rather than a broken probe.

### The docs half this card blocked is also done

The card noted that `overlay/context-menu.mdx` *"can only be made complete once this is decided"* — #7073 deliberately left the key off. `bfaa1589c` (#7456) is the most recent commit touching that page, so the docs half landed with the retirement rather than trailing it. Nothing left to file.

⚠️ For the record, this is the same trap that cost time twice earlier today on #7071 and #7088 — a tombstone comment makes a deleted thing read as *more* present. **Read the line, never the count**, and give every zero a control that fires.

Refs: #7456 (the retirement) · #7073 (the docs card that surfaced it) · #6150 · ADR-0049.
